Paying Authority: GE Shillong. 1. Consignee / Location-Wise Quantity Ser Consignee / Location Items Quantity 1 GE 868 EWS Solar Street light 30 2 GE 869 EWS Solar Street light 10 3 GE Silchar Solar Street light 21 4 AGE(I) Zakhama Solar Street light 10 5 AGE(I) Agartala Solar Street light 15 2. Additional Terms and Conditions 2.1 Scope of Supply and Work The contractor shall supply, install, test and commission of 60 W all-in-one hybrid solar street lights and fa bricate/install. structural steel mounting brackets as per the approved scope, specifications, BOQ and dra wings. 2.2 Consignee and Paying Authority The location-wise consignee as per para 1 and the Paying Authority for the contract shall be GE Shillong. T he buyer shall ensure that the consignee and payment fields in the GeM bid/contract reflect these arrange ments using the portal's permitted workflow before publication/award. 2.3 Technical Compliance and Make

The offered equipment shall comply with every essential technical parameter in the bid. The makes shown in the scope are subject to applicable GeM rules and the approved bid conditions. Where equivalent produc ts are permitted, the bidder shall submit the OEM, exact model number, datasheets and a clause-by-clause compliance statement. No essential parameter shall be relaxed without approval and only where permitte d by the bid and applicable rules. 2.4 OEM / Authorisation Documents The bidder shall provide OEM or authorised-channel documentation where required by the bid, together wi th product datasheets, model numbers, warranty terms and confirmation of availability of the complete qu antity. Any authorisation requirement must be consistent with GeM rules and the published bid conditions. 2.5 Site Inspection and Clarification Bidders shall review the scope, quantities, installation locations and site conditions before quoting. Queries or ambiguities shall be raised through the prescribed GeM clarification process within the stipulated time. The quoted price shall cover the complete scope stated in the bid, including standard accessories, installation, testing and commissioning. 2.6 Delivery and Installation Delivery and completion shall be within the period specified in the GeM bid/contract. The supplier shall coo rdinate with concerned GEs and EWSs for site access, delivery, storage, installation sequencing and inspe ction. Work includes assembly, mounting, positioning, alignment, electrical interconnections, fixing, functi onal testing and commissioning. 2.7 Testing and Acceptance Each unit shall be inspected and functionally tested at the relevant consignee location. Tests shall cover P V charging, battery/BMS and MPPT operation, dusk-to-dawn switching, fixed/PIR dimming, hybrid AC chang eover, surge protection and luminaire operation. Acceptance shall be recorded after satisfactory inspectio n, testing and submission of required documents. 2.8 Structural Steel Mounting Brackets The supplier shall fabricate and install structural steel mounting brackets, including cross-arms, bracing, s upports, clamps, back plates, cutting, bending, drilling, welding, nuts, bolts, washers, GI clamps and painti ng as described in the approved scope. The supplier shall verify dimensions and installation details with th e Engineer-in-Charge before fabrication. The unit of measurement and specification shall be as stated in th e BOQ. 2.9 Warranty and After-Sales Service The supplier shall provide the warranty period of three years and the applicable OEM warranty certificate s for the luminaire, PV module, battery, controller and associated components. Warranty shall be handled i n accordance with the contract for period of three years. The supplier shall provide service contact detail s and a complaint-response mechanism for both locations. No additional warranty duration is imposed by t his ATC unless stated in the approved specification. 2.10 Documents at Delivery The supplier shall provide invoices and delivery challans, item/model-wise packing list, serial-number list, OEM warranty certificates, technical datasheets, installation and test reports, and operation/maintenance manuals as applicable under the contract. 2.11 Payment GE Shillong shall be the Paying Authority. Payment shall be processed in accordance with the GeM contrac t and applicable financial rules after submission of the required invoice and documents, verification of quan tities, and satisfactory installation/testing and acceptance by the competent authority. Location-wise proc essing shall be followed only where supported by the contract and portal procedure.

2.12 No Unauthorised Substitution The supplier shall not change the approved make/model or any essential component, including PV module, battery chemistry/capacity, controller or luminaire, without prior written approval by the competent author ity and only where such change is permitted by the bid and GeM rules. Any approved alternative shall mee t the specified requirements and shall not increase the contract price. 2.13 Safety and Site Coordination The supplier shall coordinate with the respective GE before commencing work, comply with site security a nd safety instructions, use suitable tools and personal protective equipment, protect existing services and repair damage caused by its work. Work shall be carried out only after required site permissions are obtai ned. 2.14 General Contractual Compliance The bidder shall comply with the GeM General Terms and Conditions, the published bid conditions, applica ble procurement rules and safety requirements. Remedies for delay, non-supply, defective work or breach shall be governed by the GeM contract and applicable rules. This ATC shall not override or contradict stan dard GeM terms. .
